notes.title: The September Major Update is arriving next week!
notes.content: [p align="justify"]Hey Adventurers,[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]The development of the September update is progressing smoothly, and we’re here to share the latest updates with everyone.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]All the filter optimizations and experience improvements promised in the September preview—to be delivered before the major update—have now been fully completed. Next, we’ll focus on preparing the major version for release. It is expected to arrive next Monday or Tuesday.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Before the official update, let’s take another look at what was initially announced:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]A brand-new guidance system, making it easy even for complete beginners to get started.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/5df2f0ca8afdbdbc7f5e0cda01617b61a0a879dd.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Optimized combat logs that allow switching to more detailed battle information.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/967c35d22ee8817931b2fabfc093a78f2b659554.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Balance adjustments for all sets, along with new, more powerful sets.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/fe673cbf946d7d8f86fe2b5ce43db8cef5aa8bf3.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to the effect of the Wisdom base attribute, which also apply to already recruited mercenaries—no need to recruit them again.[/p][/*][*][p]New endgame challenge.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/60ce9d32c65ba684cbad2324beb12d838b69a70c.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]A new hidden easter egg stage that will drop large quantities of gems and runes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/ab79a236018a93319d02a06b24574566dcfb31be.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]A new equipment growth system.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/75face342a40d7531d0d7f1389aab25be3c291ea.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p align="start"][b]After the initial preview, everyone actively provided various suggestions in the discussion area, leading to the following additions:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Training Dummy feature.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/575126481546b91ff7b261257a7035172240d7ad.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]EXP Transfer System.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/a1ae6111414fc65ee0977659472c386b70939e54.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]More detailed update information will be revealed next week—please stay tuned. We welcome your continued feedback and suggestions![/p]

notes.title: An Update on the Item Filter and September's Major Patch
notes.content: [p align="justify"]Hey Adventurers,[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Following up on our September update preview, we wanted to check in and let you know how things are coming along. We're happy to report that development is progressing smoothly, and we're still on track for our scheduled release! And yes, for everyone who's been asking, this includes the highly-requested Training Dummy for testing your [b]DPS[/b]![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Additionally, as we mentioned previously, some optimizations ([i]including the brand-new equipment filter function[/i]) will be implemented before the major September patch. This plan has not changed. We will be deploying a minor update before the major version to bring you this new filter system.[/p][p align="justify"]The core of this minor update is the completely overhauled filter function. It will support a high degree of customization, allowing you to fine-tune your searches by affixes, stat values, and even attributes like "[b]Ethereal Only[/b]" It is both powerful and flexible.[/p][p align="justify"]We will also provide several default presets that you can use immediately. These presets can also be modified and exported, giving you the freedom to create your own perfect set of filter rules.[/p][p align="justify"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/9eeb3ebf5613aa8af8031a35513d7bbb645d276d.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]Now, I must apologize and inform you of a change in schedule. Because this feature was a complete rework from the ground up, we require more time for thorough testing. Based on our latest assessment, we can confirm that this minor update will not go live this week. The current estimated release window is next week, and the team will do everything possible to launch it sooner, hopefully as early as next Monday. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Finally, let us once again share a preview of the main content that will be implemented in the major September update:[/p][p align="justify"]1.A new endgame dungeon challenge.[/p][p align="justify"]- Brings a higher level of difficulty.[/p][p align="justify"]- Drops all-new Set and Legendary Items.[/p][p align="justify"]- Drops the required materials for Equipment Ascension.[/p][p align="justify"]2.The new Equipment Ascension system.[/p][p align="justify"]- Unlocks the latent potential of your gear, granting it extra stat bonuses.[/p][p align="justify"]3.A new Easter Egg stage: the Sheep Level! In this unique Level, your Mercenaries will hold their ground, fighting off endless waves of monsters in a defensive survival challenge.[/p][p align="justify"]- The drop rate for materials like Gems and Runes is ten times higher than in normal Levels.[/p][p align="justify"]- No health potions or equipment will drop in this stage.[/p][p align="justify"]- This Level is unlocked by spending a certain total amount of gold in the Shop.[/p][p align="justify"]4.New guidance pop-ups for unlocking key features.[/p][p align="justify"]5.A more detailed combat log with switchable display modes.[/p][p align="justify"]6.The Intelligence attribute has been reworked to provide a damage bonus for all skills ([i]affecting both physical and spell damage[/i]).[/p][p align="justify"]7.Existing class sets have been buffed to be powerful enough to clear all Main Levels.[/p][p align="justify"]8.A search function has been added to the stash to quickly filter for items in your inventory.[/p][p align="justify"]9.A new Training Dummy dungeon, accessible from the main town. Here you can check your party's [b]DPS[/b] data and compete on a DPS leaderboard with your friends.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]The full update will be packed with many other quality-of-life improvements and smaller tweaks.[/p][p align="justify"]As always, thank you for your incredible patience and support. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to share them with us![/p]

notes.title: 📅 Loot of Baal: September Update Preview
notes.content: [p]Dear Adventurers,[/p][p] [/p][p]It has been two weeks since the launch of the Assassin class, and in that time, we've received a massive amount of invaluable feedback. With your support, the current version has now reached a stable state. Our heartfelt thanks to all of you![/p][p]We will continue to optimize existing issues to bring you an even smoother gaming experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]Now, we are shifting our full focus to preparing for our major September update! This update will be centered on two core pillars:[/p][p]A New Beginning for Newcomers - A complete overhaul of the tutorial and onboarding system to ensure every new player can get started with ease.[/p][p]The Pinnacle Challenge for Veterans - Crafting more demanding and rewarding endgame content for our seasoned players.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]A Sneak Peek at the Major Update:[/b][/p][olist][*][p] A brand-new tutorial system, allowing players with no prior experience to quickly learn the ropes.[/p][/*][*][p] Combat Log optimizations for a clearer, at-a-glance overview of the action.[/p][/*][*][p] Balance adjustments for all class sets, along with the introduction of new, more powerful sets.[/p][/*][*][p] Adjustments to the base effects of the Wisdom attribute.[/p][/*][*][p] A new endgame challenge[/p][/*][*][p] New hidden levels and easter eggs to discover[/p][/*][*][p] A completely new equipment progression system[/p][/*][/olist][p] [/p][p]Regarding the Druid class, which many of you have asked about: rest assured, we have several new classes in the planning stages ([i]the Druid included[/i])! However, based on player surveys, our current priority is to first enhance and perfect the endgame ecosystem. New classes will be rolled out in subsequent major updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/f8ce0f311b87b7ba8c3120a8f7f8a346e5cb7d17.gif"][/img][/p][p]Regarding Tavern optimizations: the mercenary recruitment system will be revamped alongside the release of the next new class. This will ensure that expanding the recruitment pool does not negatively impact the summoning experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]As for core quality-of-life issues like the item filter, these will be implemented continuously through hotfixes, so you won't have to wait for a major version update.[/p][p]If you have more ideas, we welcome you to leave your suggestions in the comments section. Let's work together to shape an even more perfect world for adventure![/p]

notes.title: Online Mode is Back! Massive Compensation Available! Large screen mode updated
notes.content:
[p]Dear Adventurers,[/p][p]The online server has been restarted and reopened now. At the same time, support for larger interface is also added. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/f46b198859d36638a2a6946bb8a36ab56778b02e.png"][/img][/p][p]o better prevent future incidents, we’ve implemented the highest level of server protection currently available to us. We've also improved the save system—your game progress will now be backed up more frequently and reliably. We sincerely apologize. It was our lack of technical preparation that led to these issues, and we deeply regret the frustration this has caused. [/p][p]Despite our repeated efforts, we’ve confirmed that due to the unexpected nature of the recent attack, the progress loss for some players is irreversible. We are truly sorry. [/p][p]We understand that no amount of compensation can fully make up for the losses players have suffered, but we still want to do everything we can to show our appreciation and offer support. [/p][h2]Here is what we provide as immediate compensation: [/h2][olist][*][p][b]Access to the Grade A Mercenary previously available only in the demo version.[/b](*[i]Those who have already claimed them cannot claim them again[/i])[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supporter Pack claim records will be reset, allowing players who purchased it to claim the contents again.[/b](*[i]Offline players who have purchased the supporter package can still only claim it once per save file.[/i])[/p][/*][*][p][b]1 million gold, to help ease the early-game grind.,[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]1,000 Mercenary Vouchers.,[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]500 Reputation Points with all factions—this should help you unlock key Rune recipes early on and make your journey smoother.,[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][b] These rewards will be available for both online and offline saves. Available for all players enter the game before June 20th 15:30[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We also want to be honest—this experience has shaken us. While we’re doing everything within our means, we cannot yet completely eliminate the risk of high-level malicious attacks. Still, we believe the online mode deserves another chance, and we hope for your continued understanding and support. We're already in touch with several server experts who have kindly offered to help us strengthen our infrastructure even further. [/p][p]For players who prioritize stability and save security, we still recommend the offline mode for now. It remains a strong companion on your desktop, capable of offering hundreds of hours of high-quality gameplay. [/p][p]Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience we’ve caused. [/p][p]Most of our team members have only worked on offline indie games before and completely underestimated the challenges of online multiplayer-mode. Our programmers are exhausted and overwhelmed—but we’re not giving up. Thank you for sticking with us. [/p][p]If you have any questions or suggestions, we welcome you to join our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FkcQScYCkj2"]Discord Channel[/url], where someone from our team will be ready to help.

-Gleamer Studio[/p]

notes.title: Unknown Server Attack, Online Mode Temporarily Closed – Offline Mode Playable
notes.content: [p]Dear Adventurers,[/p][p]We are truly sorry. Less than 10 hours after our game launched, our servers were hit by an unidentified attack. We are urgently investigating the source and method of the intrusion. Unfortunately, some data has already been lost, and a number of players may experience issues such as missing save files. As a result, we’ve made the difficult decision to seal the affected data and temporarily shut down the game's online mode.[/p][p]The internet is a powerful place—something we are only now beginning to fully understand.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/29111af7a85c59c43da96848d0f80ff95179147c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]              The server was attacked at 11:32 AM UTC on June 17[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This incident has left us shocked and confused. We honestly don’t understand why a game like ours would become the target of such an attack. We are deeply, deeply sorry for the inconvenience this has caused. Rather than asking for your forgiveness, we are working with Steam to open a special refund channel so that affected players can request a refund. This will require Steam’s special approval, so it may take some time.[/p][p]We’re also preparing a compensation plan to make up for this unfortunate situation. In the meantime, the offline (single-player) version of the game remains fully playable, with the same content as the online version—only trading with other players is unavailable.[/p][p]Loot of Baal[i] [/i]is a labor of love, and we believe it still has many moments worth experiencing. We sincerely hope you'll give it a chance.[/p][p]Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts, for your patience, understanding, and continued support.[/p][p]— Gleamer Studio[/p]

notes.title: Larger-Screen Update & DLC Compensation
notes.content: [p][b]Dear Adventurers,[/b][/p][p]Thank you for all your feedback in the comments and community! The dev team has truly felt your passion and heard your voices. We’re currently working at full throttle to fix bugs — pulling an all-nighter today! As a small indie team, we appreciate your patience and understanding. But rest assured: we’re committed to resolving every issue, one by one.[/p][p][b]Based on gamer's feedback, here are the immediate changes we’re making to the game:[/b][/p][p][b]Content Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]We've heard your concerns about the small interface — a version with a larger interface will be released in 24 hours.[/p][/*][*][p]A full-screen version is also in development and will be coming soon.[/p][/*][*][p]New class is in the works! We plan to release the [b]Assassin[/b] class this July to bring you a richer gameplay experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/99f36d6ba729f39a6cfe970cc9ca064cf5191dad.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The issue where two accounts on the same PC each purchased the game and supporter pack but couldn’t claim the DLC — this will be fixed today.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug preventing DLC items from being claimed when your inventory is full will also be addressed.[/p][/*][*][p]If you’re having trouble claiming your DLC, feel free to contact us directly via [b]Discord - [/b]Triona will fully resolve your problem— we’ll send out compensation as soon as possible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/d00de4a3b03a26dd2fbb2faaed6bb7995f6fe5c4.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you again for your love and support! If you have any questions or suggestions, we welcome you to join our [url="https://discord.gg/kcQScYCkj2"]Discord Channel[/url], where someone from our team will be ready to help.[/p][p]Happy gaming![/p][p]—Gleamer Studio[/p]

notes.title: FAQ for Game Launch
notes.content:
[p]Thank you all for your love and support for the game![/p][p]If you encounter any issues, please join [url="https://discord.gg/hdKFpMSe"]our discord [/url]and tell us your issue. We will provide 1-on-1 assistance immediately.[/p][list][*][p]The Supporter Pack DLC can only be claimed once. It cannot be claimed again after deleting your save file. Please ensure you have enough space in your inventory when claiming the DLC.
For players who lost DLC content due to deleted save files, please contact the group admin—we will compensate you with a one-time DLC reissue.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The game servers are currently located in Singapore. If you experience frequent disconnections, please use a game accelerator. Most major accelerators support our game.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If you are experiencing issues with your demo save not transferring or encountering corrupted saves, please exit the game and send the [b]Loot of Baal[/b] save folder to the group admin.
